To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a metrics framework can be developed by starting at the highest level (USPP) and defining the metrics in a top-down manner.
a software process-integration metrics framework can be defined that is derived and defined from the top to bottom, and that the framework can be used for the purpose of process improvement.
we have defined a metrics framework that can be used by the software process practitioners to define metrics that are meaningful to the software process and to the software product.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a generalized software process-integrated metric framework and the associated metrics definition process.
the derivation of a metrics framework that is driven by user satisfaction and profitability and is integrated into the software process.
developing a metrics framework that is driven by the USPP and that can be integrated with a software process model to provide a complete and integrated framework.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the framework presented in this article can be used to define metrics for any process model, including CMMI, SPICE, or any other process models.
the metrics framework presented here provides the means of defining metrics at all the stages of a software development process.
the proposed metrics framework is a process-integrated metrics model that provides an integrated view of the software process and metrics and that is based on the USPP at the top.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a metrics framework can be defined that is driven by the USPP at the top, which is further decomposed into lower-level metrics, all linked together by the software process.
we have defined the metrics framework that is process-integrated, process-driven, and process-validated.
the proposed framework provides an effective and efficient way to define the metrics for any software process.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the software metrics framework is not only process stage dependent but also software process-integrated.
the metrics should be defined from the top down rather than bottom up.
the metrics framework is derived from the process and the process is derived from the metrics.
